question: What is the average atomic mass of a chlorine atom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**35.5 u**__.

 
• The** average atomic mass** of a **chlorine atom** is **35.5 u.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6253d2a48661fcc485dea3478a1c18c089588139c0edc0f29fbf02844c861b64.png] **

 
• **Chlorine** is the **second lightest halogen** and is represented as **Cl.**

 
 
• The** atomic number** of this chemical element is **17**.
 
• It appears as a** pale yellow-green gas.**
 
• Liquid chlorine can cause skin burn and chlorine in its gaseous form irritates the mucous membrane.
 
• Its position as per the periodic table is between fluorine and bromine.
 
• Its electronic configuration is **[Ne]3s²3p⁵**.
 
• There are two isotopes of chlorine that are stable.
 
• They are **₃₇Cl** and **₃₅Cl**, 36Cl is the stable radioisotope of chlorine
 
• Sodium chloride is the most common compound of chlorine whereas the simplest is hydrogen chloride.
 
• It is **highly reactive**.
 
• **Carl Wilhelm Scheele** who was a Swedish chemist **discovered Chlorine** in the year **1774.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8ab0a801661a1f31d0876fbd7f318b5f91bdc9c21d4b99231df84beb94aded3.png] **

• **Cl Uses (Chlorine)**

 
 
• It is used as a disinfectant
 
• Chlorine is used in the treatment of drinking water to kill bacteria
 
• It is used to clean swimming pools
 
• It is used as an antiseptic and to produce drugs
